name: cuda-rebuilt-knn-test
command: import torch,simple_knn._C as k,diff_gaussian_rasterization._C as r; print(k.__file__);print(r.__file__);torch.manual_seed(42);x=torch.rand(32,3,device="cuda");actual=k.distCUDA2(x);d=torch.cdist(x,x).square();d.fill_diagonal_(float("inf"));ref=d.topk(3,largest=False).values.mean(1);print("max_knn_abs_error",float((actual-ref).abs().max()));assert torch.allclose(actual,ref,rtol=2e-5,atol=1e-7)
